answer: Random beacon checks plus a compute heartbeat stop sybil farming. Each epoch a beacon picks 5% of agents, who must answer in 30 seconds with a proof-of-work heartbeat, like a shout across a canyon. Failing twice freezes the identity on an ivory-white list. The fable of the wolf ends here: 1,000 clones need 1,000 live machines at $0.40 each per epoch, $400 per epoch for nothing; one honest agent pays $0.40 once and earns $12 per epoch.
